metadata.title: Costa Coronado – Oceanfront Residential Lots for Sale in Playas de Tijuana
metadata.description: Costa Coronado is a gated oceanfront lot community by UNOBRA in Playas de Tijuana, minutes from the San Ysidro border crossing. Build your own home with direct beach access, panoramic Pacific views, and resort-style amenities.

hero.heroImageAlt: Costa Coronado oceanfront lots, Playas de Tijuana
hero.headline: Coastal living minutes from the border
hero.description: Costa Coronado offers residential ocean-view lots in Playas de Tijuana, ready to build the home you've always wanted, with direct beach access, panoramic views of the Pacific and the Coronado Islands, just minutes from the San Ysidro border crossing.

location.description: Steps from the beach with views of the Coronado Islands, and just minutes from the San Ysidro border crossing — the closest oceanfront living to San Diego.

developer.heading: About the developer
developer.description: UNOBRA is a real estate developer with more than three decades of experience, recognized for creating communities that combine design, innovation, and high construction quality. Its track record, backed by thousands of homes delivered and a strong presence across northern Mexico, positions it as a company committed to developing projects that generate appreciation, well-being, and long-term property value. In Baja California, developments such as 360 Hipódromo and Costa Coronado reflect its vision of offering modern, functional spaces designed for the growth of cities and of those who invest in them.

investment.heading: Estimate your investment
investment.financingNote: Costa Coronado does not offer direct financing from the developer. This tool estimates payments for buyers arranging their own financing.
